card.title: Don’t Break the Routine
card.instruction: Protect a familiar routine as though changing one step would invite chaos into everything else.

transfer.action: I move {prop} back to its usual place and restart the sequence.
transfer.opening: First the usual step, then everything else. {request}
transfer.response: Changing the order is where things unravel. {counter}
transfer.closing: Not until this way finishes reassuring me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Test the repaired kettle, but keep the tea-shoes-keys order exactly intact.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The repair means tea takes longer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you wait beside it. I won't discover a new order by accident.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I put my shoes on first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not during testing. We need one known routine left if the kettle surprises us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try the new gutter cleaner on your side before we alter our Sunday routine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually start on your side.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This is a test outside the routine, not permission to change it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's already a change.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then finish quickly so Sunday doesn't learn the difference.

card.title: Don’t Break the Routine
card.instruction: Protect a familiar routine as though changing one step would invite chaos into everything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tea, then shoes, then keys. You've touched the keys early.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now we'll need to restart the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I hold the keys while it boils?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do you want to find out why we have an order?

card.title: Try It First
card.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try the repaired tap. I've tightened something important.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if it sprays?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then point it toward the tiles. They're already wet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You turn it on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need to watch the important thing from here.

card.title: Don’t Break the Routine
card.instruction: Protect a familiar routine as though changing one step would invite chaos into everything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We always open the curtains before feeding the cat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cat's hungry now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The curtains establish morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's midday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We've already confused the cat enough.

card.title: Try It First
card.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Taste this cheap coffee substitute before I fill my cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's in it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The label calls it a blend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't tried it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's why your independent assessment will be so valuable.

card.title: Don’t Break the Routine
card.instruction: Protect a familiar routine as though changing one step would invite chaos into everything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tea, then shoes, then keys. You've picked up the keys before we've had tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're late for the train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we especially need the usual order. Otherwise we'll forget the tickets too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hold the tickets while you drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tickets go in after shoes. Please don't make us start packing again.

card.title: Don’t Break the Routine
card.instruction: Protect a familiar routine as though changing one step would invite chaos into everything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Curtains, cat food, then our breakfast. Why's his bowl already down?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He woke me early. I fed him so you could sleep.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before the curtains? Now he'll expect every meal before the day starts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll open them now. Your toast is ready too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep it warm. We need him back at the bowl before we can safely have breakfast.
